study participants after an overnight fast.
bAdapted from Barle et al. (1996) for metabolically healthy men and women with no known liver disease. Liver samples were obtained from the study participants after a 12–15 h fast.
Concentrations of amino acids in the liver were calculated on the basis of its water content (70%).
cAdapted from Perry et al. (1971). Concentrations of amino acids in the brain were calculated on the basis of its water content (70%).
